name: Governmental Gokart Miami: Truth and Julys.
author: sithblade7
description: It's the 4th of July, Mayor! The anniversary of your first election, and the day you first built a go cart! With the money we saved from your Bioluminescent Trees mandate to replace streetlights, we can finally afford hundreds of percision fireworks! Your final challenger is the current mayor-for-life overseer, and it's time to put the Politics to the Metal! Burn rubber, light the fireworks, and enjoy!
